title: NBFC Loan App List 2026: Top Apps in India
summary: NBFC loan app list for India 2026: RBI registered apps, the NBFC behind each one, and how to verify any loan app on the RBI website in two minutes.
body_markdown:
An **NBFC loan app** is a loan app whose money comes from a Non-Banking Financial Company registered with the RBI. That registration is what separates a genuine instant loan from a dangerous one: registered NBFCs follow RBI rules on interest disclosure, recovery conduct, and data privacy, while unregistered apps follow nothing.


This guide gives you the NBFC loan app list for India, explains how to verify any app in two minutes, and shows what to check before you borrow.


## What Is an NBFC, and How Is It Different from a Bank?


NBFC stands for Non-Banking Financial Company: an RBI-registered company that can lend money but cannot take regular savings deposits like a bank. For borrowers, the differences that matter are simple:


Point Bank NBFC


Regulator RBI RBI


Loan approval Stricter, slower More flexible, faster


Interest rates Usually lower Usually a little higher


Credit score needs Higher bar Often considers thinner files


Speed Days Minutes to hours on apps


That flexibility is why most instant loan apps in India run on NBFC money. The only question that matters is whether the NBFC behind the app is genuinely RBI-registered; our[7 days loan apps list](https://gromo.in/blog/7-days-loan-apps-list/) shows what happens when it is not.

## How to Verify an NBFC Loan App in 2 Minutes


1. Open the app's page or website and find the lending partner's full company name (usually in the footer, loan agreement, or Key Fact Statement).
2. Check the app in the RBI's Digital Lending Apps (DLA) directory on the RBI website (our[RBI approved loan apps](https://gromo.in/blog/rbi-approved-loan-apps/) guide explains this), which lists apps engaged by regulated lenders.
3. Cross-check the NBFC's name in the RBI's list of registered NBFCs; the registration certificate number should exist there.
4. Confirm fees, interest rate, and tenure are shown in a Key Fact Statement before any money moves.
5. If any of these four checks fails, do not borrow, whatever the app promises.


## Safety Rules for NBFC Loan Apps


- **Never pay to receive a loan.** Advance fees, GST unlock charges, and insurance-to-release demands are fraud.
- **KYC only.** A registered lender needs PAN and Aadhaar, never your contact list or photo gallery.
- **Download from official stores only** , never from APK links in WhatsApp or Telegram; our[fake loan apps list](https://gromo.in/blog/fake-loan-apps-list/) tracks known fraud apps.
- **Borrow small, repay on time.** NBFC apps report to credit bureaus, so on-time EMIs help[improve your credit score](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-improve-credit-score-india-2026/) while late ones hurt it.
- **Harassment is illegal** even from registered lenders; complain to the lender's grievance officer, then the RBI Ombudsman.


Many NBFC personal loans from partners like Moneyview, KreditBee, Kissht, InCred, Hero FinCorp, and Poonawalla Fincorp can also be compared and applied for through the[GroMo](https://gromo.in/?ref=gromo.in) app, which shows options from 30+ lenders in one place.


## FAQ: NBFC Loan App List


**What is an NBFC registered loan app?**


It is a loan app whose lending is done by a Non-Banking Financial Company registered with the RBI. The app is the storefront; the NBFC is the actual lender whose name appears in your loan agreement and Key Fact Statement.


Registered NBFCs must follow RBI rules on interest disclosure, fair recovery, and data privacy, which is what makes these apps safe compared to unregistered ones.


**Where can I find the RBI approved NBFC list for loan apps?**


Two places on the RBI website: the Digital Lending Apps (DLA) directory, which lists apps engaged by RBI-regulated lenders, and the RBI's register of NBFCs, where you can search the lending company's name. RBI approves lenders, not apps, so always verify the NBFC named inside the app rather than trusting the app's own claims.


**Which NBFC loan apps are best in India?**


For large amounts and brand trust, apps run directly by big NBFCs like Bajaj Finserv, Tata Capital, and Navi lead. For small fast loans, fintech apps backed by registered NBFCs like KreditBee, Kissht, Moneyview, and CASHe are established options.


Best depends on your amount, tenure, and profile; compare the interest rate and fees in each Key Fact Statement before choosing.


**Are NBFC loan apps safe?**


Yes, when the NBFC is genuinely RBI-registered and you follow the basics: verify the lender in the RBI directories, read the fee disclosure, refuse apps demanding contacts or gallery access, and never pay any advance fee. The danger is not NBFCs; it is unregistered apps pretending to be NBFC-backed.


**Do NBFC loan apps check and affect CIBIL score?**


Yes on both. Registered NBFCs check your credit report when you apply (a hard inquiry) and report your repayment behaviour to the bureaus every month. That cuts both ways: on-time EMIs on an NBFC app loan genuinely build your score, while defaults and late payments damage it just like a bank loan would.


## Disclaimer


This article is general information, not financial advice, and nothing here is an offer of credit. App and NBFC pairings reflect publicly available information at the time of writing; lending partners, company names, rates, and terms change with mergers and campaigns, so the app's own loan agreement, Key Fact Statement, and the RBI's directories are the only authoritative sources.
